hashNormalization: UTF-8 source with CRLF normalized to LF

protocol.raf: Native RAF scheduling is held; the real production loop callback is driven with deterministic timestamps. Requested/canceled frames are counted.
protocol.engineFailures: Inject actual illegal overlapping state into two real engine horses for RAF and skip regressions; assert detailed error, unchanged velocities and retained lastInfeasible.
protocol.constructorHistory: A genuinely completed 200m single-horse engine race is selected before a new constructor or autotest fails. Programmatic skipRace/showResult/renderResult must not settle that old object.
protocol.businessState: Check single and career tickets, bankroll, career roster/stats, sealed startedIds and isolated localStorage. The partial-week fixture supplies one complete result and then a failed second solver; repeating the week must preserve the first settlement and pay it only once.
protocol.recovery: Use the real return button, create a fresh race and drive its real loop; assert positive time, active RAF, enabled controls, hidden old notice and retained prior diagnosis.
protocol.autotest: Inject solver exception and finished-but-empty result; require a visible red failure banner and no green success claim.

results.visibleNoticeEvidence: Playwright waitFor({state:visible}) on #raceFailure after the actual engine exception, plus detailed DOM text and controls assertions.

checks.name: production RAF reports an actual engine failure and preserves the single-race ticket
return and recreate resume a healthy race while retaining the previous diagnosis
skip-to-result catches a solver failure without settling
constructor errors show a failure notice and a later healthy creation clears it
career failure keeps sealed pending bets, saved progress and diagnostic; no results are applied
automatic career simulation errors do not advance the week or settle the failed race
career constructor failure cannot expose a previously completed race for settlement
retrying a partially completed week does not settle or pay the first race twice
autotest reports failure, stops the active RAF and never claims success
autotest rejects an incomplete field instead of showing a green pass

limitations: Failure paths use explicit injected state/errors and business fixtures; this is page failure containment, not a realistic population fit or universal safety proof.
The complete numerical matrix remains a separate run on the frozen numeric engine hash.
rerunProvenance: All ten tests rerun successfully on the final query-order-preserving telemetry correction, with unchanged source and zero unhandled page errors. Earlier pre-telemetry 96d84 record retained in page-race-failure-before-telemetry-v9.json.gz.
